description: This file implements the SecureSocketPort class and its nested Handler class, providing SSL/TLS socket handling with OpenSSL integration, certificate management, and platform-specific code for Windows and non-Windows systems.

classes.name: OpenSSL
classes.description: Helper class for initializing OpenSSL library functions, ensuring one-time setup.

classes.name: Certificate
classes.description: Represents an X509 certificate, providing methods to access issuer, subject, validity period, and hostname validation.

classes.name: Key
classes.description: Represents a cryptographic key, supporting loading from files and handling private/public keys.

classes.name: CertificateStore
classes.description: Manages a collection of trusted X509 certificates, with platform-specific implementations for Windows and other OSes.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler
classes.description: Handles SSL/TLS socket operations, including handshake, certificate validation, read/write, and context management.

methods.name: ASN1_ToTime
methods.description: Converts an ASN1_TIME object to a Core::Time object.

methods.name: Certificate::Certificate
methods.description: Constructs a Certificate object from an existing x509_st pointer or loads from a file.

methods.name: Certificate::Issuer
methods.description: Returns the issuer name of the certificate.

methods.name: Certificate::Subject
methods.description: Returns the subject name of the certificate.

methods.name: Certificate::ValidFrom
methods.description: Returns the validity start time of the certificate.

methods.name: Certificate::ValidTill
methods.description: Returns the expiry time of the certificate.

methods.name: Certificate::ValidHostname
methods.description: Checks if the certificate is valid for a given hostname.

methods.name: Key::Key
methods.description: Constructs a Key object from an existing key or loads from a file, optionally with a password.

methods.name: Key::~Key
methods.description: Destructor that frees the key resource.

methods.name: CertificateStore::Add
methods.description: Adds a certificate to the store.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::CreateContext
methods.description: Creates SSL context with specified method.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes SSL connection, setting hostname and handshake state.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Read
methods.description: Reads data from SSL socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Write
methods.description: Writes data to SSL socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Open
methods.description: Opens the socket connection.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Close
methods.description: Closes the socket connection.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Certificate
methods.description: Loads a certificate and private key into the SSL context.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Root
methods.description: Sets the trusted certificate store for SSL context.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::ValidateHandShake
methods.description: Validates the peer certificate during handshake.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Update
methods.description: Performs SSL handshake steps and updates connection state.
